title: Robert C NDE 4899
content: I had my second hernia operation. They had to keep me overnight for observation. I had an IV and an antibiotic. The nurse got me out of bed to sit up. I passed out or something. I saw a bright light and went to it. There I saw my mother, grandmother and mother-in-law who approached me. They told me that I have unfinished business and had to raise my sons since I had just got divorced. I woke up screaming, 'NO, No!' I like it here!' The nurse and doctors tried to say I had a reaction to the antibiotic but I woke all sweaty and my IV was out and I was all wet.

elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It might have been a few seconds but it seemed longer.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes My mother, grandmother and mother-in-law and she was the only one who talked to me! She said I had to take care of my sons and then shoved me back.

elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
